'''"Brassie"''' was the individual name of a [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] [[Flurry II combat cloud car]].<ref name="Bartyn's Landing" />

Around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], the Flurry II was a brand-new model. [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]] provided its [[Security Chief (ORO)]] of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]], [[Mix Liddell]], with a shiny, bronze-colored Flurry II that he named "Brassie".<ref name="Bartyn's Landing" />

Liddell used "Brassie", one of the few air vehicles of Lamaredd, for aerial patrols, and parked it on the roof of his office. In little time, "Brassie" became battered and no longer shiny.<ref name="Bartyn's Landing" />
